title: A finite type sheaf lives on a finitely presented closed subscheme with prescribed fibre support
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a finite type morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum], let $\mathcal F$ be a finite-type quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $x\in X$, $s=f(x)$. Write $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-residue-field] and let $\mathcal F_s$ be the pullback of $\mathcal F$ to $X_s$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. There exist a closed immersion $j:Z\to X$ of finite presentation [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] and a finite-type quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Z$-module $\mathcal H$ such that $j_*\mathcal H\cong\mathcal F$ and the underlying closed subset $|Z\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)|$ of $|X_s|$ equals $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F_s)=\{u\in X_s:(\mathcal F_s)_u\ne0\}$. Here $j_*\mathcal H(V)=\mathcal H(j^{-1}V)$ for open subsets $V\subseteq X$.
